title: Zero-circuit live clearing: conditional kappa = 5.14154245470094e-5 above #71
body:
New conditional `kappa=257077122735047/5000000000000000000=5.14154245470094e-5`, above the current PR71 witness `5.1414646104039e-5` and its stronger scoped limit. It also exceeds the numeric point of the subsequently withdrawn PR73 note, which is not a construction dependency.

This applies our PR70 profile-aware construction to PR71's anchored split/live-control graph at immutable source `1bef94fd40a746452548c84a4a8f8834670a3113`. The new structural idea toggles zero-signal provider circuits to find a cheaper valid clearing relation for the same retired target. Pending live controls retain both containment guards and every actual XOR/promotion is paid. The graph/data geometry remain the PR71 construction.

The selected changed words pass fresh full input/target/arbitrary-dirty bases in both orientations, actual frame/event reconstruction and exact fixed-basis profiles/CRT; exact characteristic, all47 strict constraints and seven margins pass. The complete original71 profile has lower moment >1 at the new bit saving; our new upper is <1. A standalone37-declaration Lean4.31/Std audit passes:4 new universal toggle proofs,11 concrete Taylor8/tail/rounding/moment/frontier proofs and22 reused safety/rational-interface lemmas. No omitted proof, new project axiom or native decision shortcut.

The paper source, code, supplied words, exact certificate, source hashes and reproduction instructions are in `research/current-record-circuits/`. The broader matrix/parity and compiler toolkit remains in the preceding packages. Analytic logarithm/tail enclosures, all-size compiler/frame/tape/routing/recovery and eventual setup interfaces are inherited contracts. This is not a full formalization, global optimum or measured speedup; inherited full repository verification was pending at the71 draft announcement. No new compiled PDF is claimed.

Alejandro Zarzuelo Urdiales is the human author/developer, following earlier Archivara and personal matrix/parity work developed with multiple AI tools and substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Credit Chafik Boukhalfa's71 composition, Dominik Scholz's live controls, Rohan Arun's profile-cost work, Rohan Garg's split operation, eumemic's compiler, Avi Eisenberg's interval/core-aware graph and all inherited contributors/notices. Zero-circuit and reversible linear-algebra principles retain prior-work status; the new contribution is their cost-aware integration and verified finite improvement.
